Bun

Documentation   •   Discord   •   Issues   •   Roadmap
### [Read the docs →](https://bun.com/docs) ## What is Bun? Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps. It ships as a single executable called `bun`. At its core is the _Bun runtime_, a fast JavaScript runtime designed as **a drop-in replacement for Node.js**. It's written in Rust and powered by JavaScriptCore under the hood, dramatically reducing startup times and memory usage. ```bash bun run index.tsx # TS and JSX supported out-of-the-box ``` The `bun` command-line tool also implements a test runner, script runner, and Node.js-compatible package manager. Instead of 1,000 node_modules for development, you only need `bun`. Bun's built-in tools are significantly faster than existing options and usable in existing Node.js projects with little to no changes. ```bash bun test # run tests bun run start # run the `start` script in `package.json` bun install # install a package bunx cowsay 'Hello, world!' # execute a package ``` ## Install Bun supports Linux (x64 & arm64), macOS (x64 & Apple Silicon), and Windows (x64 & arm64). > **Linux users** — Kernel version 5.6 or higher is strongly recommended, but the minimum is 5.1. > **x64 users** — if you see "illegal instruction" or similar errors, check our [CPU requirements](https://bun.com/docs/installation#cpu-requirements-and-baseline-builds) ```sh # with install script (recommended) curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash # on windows powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1 | iex" # with npm npm install -g bun # with Homebrew brew tap oven-sh/bun brew install bun # with Docker docker pull oven/bun docker run --rm --init --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 oven/bun ``` ### Upgrade To upgrade to the latest version of Bun, run: ```sh bun upgrade ``` Bun automatically releases a canary build on every commit to `main`. To upgrade to the latest canary build, run: ```sh bun upgrade --canary ``` [View canary build](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/tag/canary) ## Quick links - Intro - [What is Bun?](https://bun.com/docs/index) - Bun

Documentation   •   Discord   •   Issues   •   Roadmap

Read the docs →

What is Bun?

Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps. It ships as a single executable called bun.

At its core is the Bun runtime, a fast JavaScript runtime designed as a drop-in replacement for Node.js. It's written in Rust and powered by JavaScriptCore under the hood, dramatically reducing startup times and memory usage.

bun run index.tsx             # TS and JSX supported out-of-the-box

The bun command-line tool also implements a test runner, script runner, and Node.js-compatible package manager. Instead of 1,000 node_modules for development, you only need bun. Bun's built-in tools are significantly faster than existing options and usable in existing Node.js projects with little to no changes.

bun test                      # run tests
bun run start                 # run the `start` script in `package.json`
bun install <pkg>             # install a package
bunx cowsay 'Hello, world!'   # execute a package

Install

Bun supports Linux (x64 & arm64), macOS (x64 & Apple Silicon), and Windows (x64 & arm64).

Linux users — Kernel version 5.6 or higher is strongly recommended, but the minimum is 5.1.

x64 users — if you see "illegal instruction" or similar errors, check our CPU requirements

# with install script (recommended)
curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash

# on windows
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1 | iex"

# with npm
npm install -g bun

# with Homebrew
brew tap oven-sh/bun
brew install bun

# with Docker
docker pull oven/bun
docker run --rm --init --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 oven/bun

Upgrade

To upgrade to the latest version of Bun, run:

bun upgrade

Bun automatically releases a canary build on every commit to main. To upgrade to the latest canary build, run:

bun upgrade --canary

View canary build

aiSummary.oneLiner: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager natively written in Zig.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Bun is an all-in-one toolkit and incredibly fast JavaScript runtime built from scratch in Zig. It utilizes JavaScriptCore to deliver dramatically faster startup times and lower memory usage compared to Node.js. Beyond the runtime, Bun consolidates the entire JavaScript development ecosystem by natively bundling a blazing-fast package manager, an integrated bundler, and a Jest-compatible test runner. This eliminates the need for complex, fragmented toolchains like Webpack, Babel, or npm. By functioning as a drop-in replacement for Node.js, it simplifies full-stack engineering with native support for TypeScript and JSX.
keyFeatures: High-Performance Runtime: Executes JavaScript and TypeScript significantly faster than Node.js by utilizing Apple's JavaScriptCore engine.
Native Package Manager: Replaces npm, yarn, or pnpm with an integrated, ultra-fast dependency resolver and installer.
Integrated Test Runner: Provides a built-in, Jest-compatible testing framework heavily optimized for speed and immediate execution.
Built-in Bundler: Natively bundles and transpiles TypeScript and JSX without requiring external plugins or complex configurations.
Node.js Compatibility: Delivers seamless drop-in compatibility with existing Node.js APIs and npm packages to ease migration.
Single Executable: Ships as a solitary binary tool that eliminates the need for sprawling node_modules development environments.

useCases.title: Accelerating CI/CD Pipelines
useCases.description: Replacing slow npm install and test steps in continuous integration environments with near-instant tooling.

useCases.title: Running High-Performance Servers
useCases.description: Deploying backend web servers that leverage a highly optimized HTTP networking stack for maximum throughput.

useCases.title: Simplifying the JS Toolchain
useCases.description: Consolidating fragmented setups containing Node, Webpack, Jest, and npm into a single cohesive binary.

useCases.title: Rapid TypeScript Development
useCases.description: Executing TypeScript files directly from the command line without needing a separate manual compilation step.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Full-stack developers, frontend engineers, and backend teams seeking a faster, simpler, and fully integrated toolchain for JavaScript and TypeScript projects. It dramatically reduces friction for teams looking to modernize their build pipelines.
